nights.title: Kid Kapichi - Down the Rabbit Hole
nights.name: Kid Kapichi
nights.extract: Kid Kapichi are an English punk rock band formed in Hastings in 2013. The band consists of vocalist and guitarist Jack Wilson and bassist Eddie Lewis.

nights.title: Enter Shikari
nights.name: Enter Shikari
nights.extract: Enter Shikari are an English rock band formed in St Albans, Hertfordshire in 1999 by bassist Chris Batten, lead vocalist and keyboardist Rou Reynolds, and drummer Rob Rolfe. In 2003, guitarist Rory Clewlow joined the band to complete its current line-up, and it adopted its current name.

en.who: Enter Shikari are an English rock band formed in St Albans, Hertfordshire, by Chris Batten, Rou Reynolds and Rob Rolfe.
facts: The band was formed in St Albans, Hertfordshire, in 1999.
Guitarist Rory Clewlow joined in 2003, and the band adopted its current name then.

de.who: Enter Shikari ist eine englische Rockband, die 1999 in St Albans, Hertfordshire, gegründet wurde. Gründungsmitglieder waren Chris Batten, Rou Reynolds und Rob Rolfe.
facts: Die Band entstand 1999 in St Albans, Hertfordshire.

tr.who: Enter Shikari, 1999'da Hertfordshire'ın St Albans kentinde Chris Batten, Rou Reynolds ve Rob Rolfe tarafından kurulmuş bir İngiliz rock grubudur.
facts: Grup 1999'da St Albans, Hertfordshire'de kuruldu.
2003'te gitarist Rory Clewlow katıldı ve grup bugünkü adını aldı.

nights.title: Cheekface
nights.name: Cheekface
nights.extract: Cheekface is an American indie rock band based in Los Angeles, California. Formed in 2017, the group consists of guitarist and lead vocalist Greg Katz, bassist and backup vocalist Amanda Tannen, and drummer Mark Edwards. Cheekface has released six studio albums, five EPs, and one live album, all on Katz's own label, New Professor Music.

en.kicker: american indie rock band · los angeles, 2017

tr.who: Cheekface, Los Angeles, California merkezli bir Amerikan indie rock grubudur. Tüm yayınları gitarist Greg Katz'ın kendi plak şirketi New Professor Music'te çıkıyor.

nights.title: The Fray - Autumn Light Tour
nights.name: The Fray
nights.extract: The Fray is an American rock band from Denver, Colorado, formed in 2002 by schoolmates Isaac Slade and Joe King. Their debut studio album, How to Save a Life (2005) was released by Epic Records and received quadruple platinum certification by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA), as well as platinum certification in Australia, Canada, New Zealand and the United Kingdom. Its release was supported by their first hit single, "Over My Head ", which peaked at number eight on the Billboard Hot 100. en.who: The Fray is an American rock band from Denver, Colorado, formed in 2002 by schoolmates Isaac Slade and Joe King. Their debut album, How to Save a Life, received quadruple platinum certification in the United States.
facts: The band was formed in 2002 by schoolmates Isaac Slade and Joe King.
Their single How to Save a Life peaked at number three on the chart.

nights.title: Eagles of Death Metal
nights.name: Eagles of Death Metal
nights.extract: Eagles of Death Metal is an American rock band from Palm Desert, California, formed in 1998. Founded by Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme (drums), the band includes a wide range of other musicians who perform both on the band's studio albums and at live shows.

en.who: Eagles of Death Metal is an American rock band from Palm Desert, California, founded by Jesse Hughes and Josh Homme, who plays drums.
facts: The band was formed in 1998 in Palm Desert, California.
A wide range of other musicians perform on its studio albums and at live shows.

de.who: Eagles of Death Metal ist eine amerikanische Rockband aus Palm Desert, Kalifornien, gegründet von Jesse Hughes und Josh Homme, der am Schlagzeug sitzt.

nights.title: Richard Shindell
nights.name: Richard Shindell
nights.extract: Richard Shindell is an American folk singer, songwriter, producer, and musician. Shindell grew up in Port Washington, New York, and now lives in Buenos Aires, Argentina, with his wife, Lila Caimari, a university professor, and their children.

en.who: Richard Shindell is an American folk singer, songwriter, producer and musician. He grew up in Port Washington, New York, and now lives in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
facts: Shindell is an American folk singer, songwriter, producer, and musician.

tr.kicker: amerikalı folk şarkıcısı ve söz yazarı

facts: Richard Shindell bir Amerikalı folk şarkıcısı, söz yazarı, yapımcı ve müzisyendir.
Buenos Aires'te eşi Lila Caimari, üniversite öğretim üyesi, ve çocuklarıyla birlikte yaşıyor.

nights.title: Chloe Slater
nights.name: Chloe Slater
nights.extract: Chloe Leanne Slater is an English singer-songwriter based in Manchester. Writing about social and political issues, she has been releasing music since 2023 and has issued two extended plays: You Can't Put a Price on Fun, and Love Me Please.

en.who: Chloe Slater is an English singer-songwriter based in Manchester. Her songs address social and political issues.
facts: She has been releasing music since 2023.
She has issued two extended plays, You Can't Put a Price on Fun and Love Me Please.

de.who: Chloe Slater ist eine englische Singer-Songwriterin aus Manchester. Ihre Texte handeln von sozialen und politischen Themen.

tr.who: Chloe Slater, Manchester merkezli bir İngiliz şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Şarkılarında sosyal ve siyasi konuları işliyor.
